content: Implement and qualify M0100 Core Foundation across W0101-W0106: close blocking decisions with evidence, deliver the ecosystem-neutral runtime/contracts, PTX and CPU execution pipeline, CUDA Driver and NVML compatibility providers, managed/passthrough modes, packaging, and milestone acceptance without relaxing durable constraints.

The qualification host is x86_64 AMD Ryzen 7 H 255 running Linux 6.18.42 and Clang 22.1.8, without installed CUDA/NVML headers, an NVIDIA GPU, or stock nvidia-smi. It can supply AMD evidence only; Intel and NVIDIA stock-tool evidence require separate fixtures or hosts and remain open.

D0012 freezes the v0.1 distribution matrix without raising the glibc 2.31 floor. D0013 requires a same-build vendor CUDA/NVML pair loaded from validated canonical paths. D0014 isolates compiler caches by peer UID with quotas, atomic publication, deterministic eviction, and a read-only administrator AOT tier. D0015 derives workers from effective physical cores and uses NUMA-local, CTA-granularity scheduling without oversubscription or default cross-node stealing.

D0016 freezes immutable CUDA/NVML ABI inputs for R535, R550, R570, R580, and R610 from signed repository metadata, exact packages, extracted headers, and explicit manifest epochs. Header, license, package, ELF, and C17/C++20 input checks passed; packaged runtime compatibility across the declared matrix remains open.

D0017 freezes compiler-epoch-1 PTX 9.0/sm_70 at 31 instruction forms and 17 hashed positive, malformed, unsupported, and edge fixtures. Capability, form, index, and aggregate digests were revalidated; frontend, Kernel IR, interpreter, rejection, randomized differential, and sanitizer tests passed.

D0018 freezes LLVM 22.1.8 with one upstream LoopAccessAnalysis correctness backport. The full upstream graph completed 72,596 tests: 70,001 passed, 202 expected failures, 2,376 unsupported, and 17 skipped, with no unexpected failure; the project SDK and llvm-186922 reproducer also passed.

D0019 selects a static MLIR/LLVM component closure for generic daemon releases and retains private shared framework DSOs only as a qualification comparison. The canonical M0100 records own the startup, RSS, and payload measurements supporting this choice.

D0020 routes byte-identical downloads through mirrors in the current execution environment's configured timezone, then the nearest adjacent timezone, with no permanent country or region priority. Canonical upstream identity, signatures, revisions, and frozen hashes remain authoritative.

The apparent offline release-matrix pass was invalidated because a POSIX-shell helper using `! grep` could return success after detecting forbidden content. Replacement helpers distinguish no match, forbidden match, and scan failure, and their fault-injection self-test passed. The full release matrix remains unqualified and must be rerun after source freeze.

Expected-even fence recovery, tagged payload hazards, update/publication convergence, and close-time attempt/lease sealing with late-writer quarantine passed 300 ordinary and 100 ASan/UBSan fault cycles; an independent repeat passed the runtime, shared-layout, registry, recovery, and model set for 20 ordinary and 10 sanitizer rounds.

nvmlDeviceSetPersistenceMode and nvmlDeviceSetComputeMode use observer control opcodes with root/daemon-UID checks, stable fence publication before response, idempotence, and cross-session getter visibility. Focused validation passed 7/7 ordinary and 5/5 ASan/UBSan tests; both symbols export from libnvidia-ml.so.1 and the host provider directly needs only libc.so.6.

Content revision 7b86b35552c0a52661071cf6a74b76aef1faf289 is the implementation provenance checkpoint. Its external CMake dev configure/build and all 58 CTest cases passed; the optimization and measurement runner self-tests each passed 12/12. This is an implementation checkpoint, not release certification.

D0022 supersedes D0021 for continuation: Git owns source history; toolchains/ owns tool identity; Nix only materializes fixed tools; CMake/Ninja, CTest, packaging, and evidence producers own their workflows; sessions remain curated ledgers; host cleanup remains explicit operator policy. Continue from current main with external work directories.

Content revision 694272a fixes cgroup cpuset fallback for scopes without cpuset controller (walk-up hierarchy search with affinity/online-node fallback). W0102/W0103/W0104 work doc checkboxes updated to reflect full implementation audit. Dev CTest59/59 pass; ASan CTest59/59 pass. Recovery stress50/50 ordinary +20/20 ASan zero failures. Million-noop daemon stress30-iteration run in progress. AMD reference host fingerprint captured (AMD Ryzen 7 H 255, AuthenticAMD, glibc 2.42, Clang 22.1.8).

Adopted D0026 guidance after validating it against the current summary and event evidence. Replaced the legacy knowledge-summary shape with exact roast-depth and independent session-only sections, preserved every product result and evidence identity, and classified only claims materially promoted by this session.
